title: GPU-unlock: FP/BF16 instruction issue rate on Nvidia 3000's cards
script:
Nvidia three thousand series cards have a hidden performance limitation.
Developer Zagitta released a Linux kernel module to address this.
The module adjusts internal hardware speed selectors to reset the chip state.
It targets the FP16 and BF16 instruction issue rate on these GPUs.
This specifically allows the hardware to reach higher compute performance levels.
Zagitta notes this requires specific Linux kernel configurations to function correctly.
Would you modify your kernel for these performance gains?
